prompt: A contact sheet of six separate food photographs arranged in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, each subject centred in its own invisible square cell of equal size (cells are 768 by 768 px), on one continuous seamless flat matte warm cream ground (#F4E6C4), with no lines, borders or labels between cells and a generous empty margin (at least 12 percent) around each subject so nothing touches a cell edge. All six shot identically: three-quarter elevated angle (about 40 degrees), soft warm daylight from the upper left, very soft short contact shadow under each item, the same sharp realistic editorial food-photography look, real appetising colours. Crockery: matte deep forest-green (#233929) and off-white ceramic, brushed steel. The reference image only shows the look of the bowl, light and food realism: do not copy its composition or ground colour. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) naan ail et fromage: a naan with melted cheese, chopped garlic and coriander, cut in wedges, on a steel plate; (2) chapati: a thin round whole-wheat flatbread with a few light brown spots, folded in half, on a steel plate; (3) naan chocolat noisette: a round naan generously spread with glossy chocolate-hazelnut spread, a few chopped hazelnuts on top, cut in wedges, on a green plate; (4) cookie caramel cacahuète: a thick golden cookie with caramel drizzle and whole roasted peanuts, a second cookie behind, on a green plate; (5) fromage blanc, coulis de mangue et muesli: a clear glass cup layered with white fromage blanc, bright orange mango coulis and crunchy muesli on top, a small spoon beside; (6) sandwich à composer: a long toasted flatbread sandwich cut in half showing grilled chicken tikka, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion and white sauce, on a steel tray. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no printed packaging, no hands, no people. Original images, not copies of any brand's photos.
